The '''"Longsight" electrobinoculars''' were a model of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] produced by the [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] for use providing optical enhancement. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and cost 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
